Media Credentialing

The HVHC accredits print, broadcast, and digital media for regular-season and Lewis Cup playoff games. Outlets must apply at the start of each season; individual game requests are also accepted but receive lower priority for press-box seating. Photographers are limited to designated photo wells at all eight arenas.

To apply, email media@hvhc.org with your outlet name, primary contact, beat assignment, and a sample clip. Responses typically take 3-5 business days. Single-game credentials must be requested at least 48 hours before puck drop.

Press releases, photo embargoes, and statistical reports are distributed via the league's media list. Sign up by emailing media@hvhc.org with subject "Media List."

Visit us

Getting to the Office

The HVHC office occupies the 2nd floor of the historic Liberty Building in downtown Poughkeepsie, three blocks from the Poughkeepsie train station on Metro-North's Hudson Line. Walk-in visitors should buzz Suite 220 at the Liberty Street entrance; metered street parking is available on Liberty and Main, with the Civic Center garage one block south.

Mailing address is the same as the street address. Equipment shipments, sponsorship deliveries, and player records should be addressed to the appropriate department on the envelope. The league does not maintain a separate PO box.

Eight HVHC clubs and 28 sanctioned partner youth associations operate across Dutchess, Ulster, Greene, Columbia, and Delaware counties. The league office can route inquiries to the appropriate youth program upon request.

By the Numbers

  • Founded: 1998 (charter season)
  • Clubs: 8 (4 charter)
  • Games per season: 168 reg. + 11 playoff
  • Registered players: ~ 180
  • Sanctioned by: USA Hockey
  • Tax status: 501(c)(3) non-profit
  • EIN: 14-1980091
HVHC U18 AA Junior Hockey · Est. 1998

Hudson Valley Hockey Conference is a non-profit U18 AA junior hockey league sanctioned by USA Hockey and serving the Hudson Valley region of New York since 1998.
